vocab_words.example: New hires undergo a three-month probation period.
The candidate impressed the interview panel.
The company handled the complaint promptly.
Customers can request a refund within 30 days.
We received an inquiry about the product warranty.

vocab_words.meaning: phản hồi, ý kiến đóng góp
vocab_words.example: Customer feedback helps us improve our service.
The staff were courteous and helpful.
The team worked to resolve the issue quickly.
The warehouse conducts inventory checks monthly.
The shipment is expected to arrive next week.

items.question: The document must be reviewed carefully ___ submitting it.
items.explanation: Ngữ cảnh cần trước khi nộp thì phải xem lại tài liệu, dùng "before".

items.question: The negotiation process took longer ___ anyone had anticipated.
items.explanation: So sánh hơn dùng "than", không phải "then".

items.question: The manager insisted that the report ___ revised before submission.
items.explanation: Sau "insist that" trong câu giả định trang trọng, dùng động từ nguyên mẫu "be".

items.question: The manager will be ___ for approving all expense reports.
The company's revenue ___ substantially since the merger.
items.explanation: "Since + mốc thời gian" đi cùng thì hiện tại hoàn thành.

items.question: The manager praised the team for their ___ to the project.
items.explanation: Cần danh từ sau tính từ sở hữu "their".

items.question: The factory has implemented new procedures to ___ workplace accidents.
items.explanation: Sau "to" (mục đích) cần động từ nguyên mẫu.

items.question: The new policy will take effect ___ the beginning of next month.
items.explanation: Cụm cố định "at the beginning of" dùng giới từ "at".

items.question: Despite the heavy rain, the outdoor event ___ as scheduled.
items.explanation: Câu kể lại sự việc đã xảy ra trong quá khứ nên dùng thì quá khứ đơn.

items.question: The workshop will be held ___ further notice.
items.explanation: Cụm cố định "until further notice" nghĩa là cho đến khi có thông báo mới.
